verdict.rationale: Vast.ai ships a first-party `vastai` agent skill that lets AI coding assistants operate the account on the user's behalf, including creating instances, deploying endpoints and managing SSH keys. Natural-language operation therefore works, but only through a third-party coding agent; the evidence shows no built-in natural-language interface in the console or CLI. missing for 10: a native natural-language interface in the product itself, detailed documentation of the skill's coverage and limits, and hands-on or independent corroboration that the skill works in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: The `vastai` agent skill lets AI coding assistants drive Vast.ai on your behalf — create instances, deploy endpoints, manage SSH keys, check balances, and more
A **skill** or **plugin** lets an agent operate your **account** — find, rent, launch, and tear down instances.
Install the skill into your coding agent with one command: npx skills add vast-ai/vast-cli --skill vastai
